title: Qwen3.6-27B pair-produced Q4 gate shared-activation engine decision

candidate.description: Route all 48 Q4T16 K5,120/N6,144 linear-attention gates through the exact adjacent-pair source-F16 producer at rows 512-2047. In the 24 Q6-QKV layers, the existing pair ABI also shares the FP16 activation cast.
candidate.proposed_fallback: exact Q4T16 gate at M2048/4K, decode, verifier/MTP, model/backend/registry misses

complete_category_quality.scope: ten committed prompts, four categories, 330 forced-prefix transitions, exact Q4 gate owner versus pair-produced bounded source-F16 policy
complete_category_quality.note: The initial assertion expected only 24 Q6-QKV peers. Runtime correctly applies the shape policy to all 48 Q4 gates, so the corrected expected delta is 48 layers x 3 M512 tiles = 144 launches per candidate prompt.

counterbalanced_full_engine.protocol: One resident XTX session per shape; complete prior package retained; baseline removes only Q4 K5,120/N6,144 tile/variant/max-row policies; candidate restores them; seven alternating pairs; d128 exact ownership.
counterbalanced_full_engine.binding_decision: Reject on XTX M512: -0.181% paired median with only 1/7 wins. The 1K +0.093% result does not compensate because the objective is the remaining M512 gap and policies are retained only when same-suite non-regressive.
counterbalanced_full_engine.w7900_skipped: The binding XTX M512 row already failed decisively, so no additional W7900 GPU time was spent.
counterbalanced_full_engine.safeguards_skipped: Decode is identical-owner and stable in the completed A/B rows, but full MTP/DFlash/trace/publication safeguards were not run after the performance rejection.

invalid_4k_attempt.symptom: The baseline label reported a nonzero pair delta at M4096 and the harness stopped before measurement.
invalid_4k_attempt.cause: The harness mutated backend package policy maps after the resident session had already frozen its normalized row-ceiling policy, so removing the package shape did not remove the active session owner.
invalid_4k_attempt.impact: No 4K timing or correctness evidence was published from this attempt. Runtime removal makes the production 4K owner the unchanged exact Q4T16 fallback.

reconciliation_with_leaf.leaf: The isolated actual-weight Q6-QKV/Q4-gate pair improved 1.106x-1.169x across M512/M1024 and both boards with 58/60 wins.
reconciliation_with_leaf.engine: Applying the shape policy to all 48 gates adds 144 producer/GEMM/cast tile dispatches at M512 and does not improve complete engine wall. The isolated pair did not model all gates or the full scheduling/launch-pressure cost.
reconciliation_with_leaf.retained_evidence: Keep the runtime-unwired leaf artifact as diagnostic mechanism evidence; remove package ownership and production tests/docs immediately.

decision: Reject and remove the K5,120/N6,144 runtime policy. The complete quality gate passes, but binding XTX M512 regresses with 1/7 wins and 1K is only marginally positive. Restore the exact Q4T16 gate owner everywhere, keep the later pair-produced shared-activation leaf as runtime-unwired diagnostic evidence, and do not claim throughput, W7900, 4K, MTP, DFlash, or production-trace qualification.
